checks.fix: Run tools/backup-identity.mjs. Losing these keys loses every DID, every claimed room, and every signed receipt — there is no recovery.

checks.fix: An always-on host removes the gaps. Note a rented validator box would run this too, so the two decisions collapse into one purchase.
